name: place
description: Place overlays on the timeline: one, or several at once with items (each checked first, one sheet back). At seconds, or at a spoken phrase ({phrase, take}: clean, first or last; transcribes clips that have no transcript, beside the clip). The overlay is a JSX file in the project (write it with write_project_overlay) or a preset (lower_third, callout; flow, ring, rule move) with props; its Google Fonts are taken from its own font stacks. Adds it on a free overlay track; id names a new item, or moves or updates that existing item only. A human edit to the tracks since it read them is refused. Checks the placed overlay fits the frame and the safe areas.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {id, start, end, track, take?, fonts?, also? (each other sentence that says the phrase), issues?, sheet} (with items: {placed: [those], sheet}). detail adds src, said (the matched words), language and the measured text.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: at
params.description: Timeline seconds, or {"phrase": "...", "take": "clean"|"first"|"last"}. Required unless id is given.

params.name: for
params.description: Seconds on screen. Default 3, or the item's own length when moving one. Not with until.

params.name: until
params.description: Timeline seconds it ends at, instead of for.

params.name: overlay
params.description: A JSX file in the project folder (its path), e.g. overlays/title.jsx.

params.name: preset
params.description: An engine preset instead of overlay. lower_third: props text, subtitle. callout: props text, anim (pop, slide, fade). Moving, to show an idea before any text: flow (a signal travelling between labels): props points ("phone > computer > motors"), at?; ring (a pulse on a live subject): props x, y (shares of the frame), label?; rule (a line drawn under a subject with a word): props text, y, width?.

params.name: props
params.description: Props as a JSON object: text, color, bgColor, fontSize, fontFamily, ... Merged into an item's own when updating.

params.name: track
params.description: The overlay track id to place it on. Default: the top graphics track free at that time, else a new one on top.

params.name: id
params.description: A new item's id, or the existing overlay item to move or update instead of adding one.

params.name: items
params.description: Several placements in one call: a list of {at, for?, until?, overlay | preset, props?, track?, id?}, every one checked before any is written, one sheet back. Instead of the single-item params.

params.name: language
params.description: The speaker's language code for a phrase (fillers and transcription). Default: what the transcript says, or detected.

params.name: model
params.description: Whisper model for clips with no transcript.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer the src, the matched words and the measured text.
